SELECT DISTINCT t2.dataset_id as datasetId, t2.dataset_name as datasetName, t2.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner FROM ssm_dataset_ctg_inherit t1 inner join ssm_dataset t2 on t1.item_value = t2.dataset_id WHERE t1.item_type = 'dataset' AND t1.is_inherited = 1 and t2.is_active = 1

SELECT DISTINCT t2.ctg_name as `name`, t2.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner FROM ssm_dataset_ctg_inherit t1 INNER JOIN ssd_field_ctg t2 ON t1.item_value = t2.ctg_id INNER JOIN ssm_dataset_ctg_rel t3 ON t2.ctg_id = t3.ctg_id WHERE t1.item_type = 'ctg' AND t1.is_inherited = 1 AND t2.is_active = 1 AND t2.parent_ctg_id = '-1' AND t3.dataset_id = #{datasetId}
